c74object.name: evi.filter~
c74object.digest: All-in-one TPT twopole filter section with a choice of 12 different filter types
c74object.description:
evi.filter~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
This filter block can be switched between 12 different filter types. The filter is a clean twopole TPT SVF section which can be used in place of a biquad as it has superior properties to a biquad. It is designed to be an every day patching workhorse for most linear filtering needs. Each individual filter type can also be instantiated in it's own all-in-one block, see the 'seealso' for details. The TPT SVF is used all over evieve whenever basic filtering is required.

inlet.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz of the selected filter type.
± gain in dB of the selected filter type.
Q, typically clamped in the range 0.05..20, but the 'Resonant' filter type (index # 6) can take a much higher Q.

attribute.name: filter
attribute.description: Set the filter type by integer index: 0=Bypass, 1=Lowpass, 2=Highpass, 3=Bandpass, 4=Peak, 5=Notch, 6=Resonant, 7=Bell (default), 8=BellAdaptiveQ, 9=Lowshelf, 10=Highshelf, 11=Tilt, 12=Allpass

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smooth the mixing gains of the filter efficiently at the core of the DSP. With these TPT SVF filters this will usually be the only smoothing required. By default smoothing is off.

c74object.discussion: For a complete list of the available filter types (by index) double-click the abstraction and look at the comments at the top of the code block.
